item.title: fix(update): prevent overlapping managed handoffs (#123116)
item.summary: fix(update): prevent overlapping managed handoffs (#123116) * fix(update): serialize managed handoffs across restarts Prevent replacement Gateways and named profiles from launching overlapping updaters for the same canonical install root. A secure host-scoped SQLite coordinator follows the updater process identity through the detached handoff. Closes #123108 * fix(update): use runner fallback on Windows Keep process.execve on supported platforms and retain the lease-owning runner around the update child on Windows. * fix(update): identify Windows handoff processes Persist and compare the Windows process creation time so a reused PID cannot suppress a later managed update.
